bullets.text: Pixel 10's Magic Cue Expands - **Google** is enhancing the Pixel 10's Magic Cue feature with **Tasks** and **Wallet** integration.
iPhone 18 Pro Rumors - The **iPhone 18 Pro** may feature under-display **Face ID** and new **Samsung** display tech.
Samsung's Home Up Upgrade - **Samsung** is enhancing its **One UI 8.5** with new homescreen tools for **Good Lock** users.
iOS 26 Photos App Feature - **Apple**'s **Photos** app now groups event photos and provides insights like set lists.
Snap Settles Addiction Lawsuit - **Snap** has settled a lawsuit alleging its platform contributes to social media addiction.
Amagi's IPO Performance - **Amagi**'s shares slid in its India debut after raising ₹17.89 billion in an IPO.
ChatGPT's Age Prediction - **OpenAI** introduces an age prediction feature in **ChatGPT** to protect young users.
Netflix's App Redesign - **Netflix** plans to revamp its mobile app to compete with social platforms for user engagement.
Humans& Raises $480M - **Humans&**, a human-centric AI startup, secured $480 million in seed funding at a $4.48 billion valuation.
Ethernovia Secures $90M - **Ethernovia** raises $90 million to advance developments in 'physical AI' technologies.
